rationale: §65.8: a program-global `@charset` becomes "the very first thing in the sheet (byte 0)" — only there does it decide the sheet's encoding — and `@import` "follows the `@layer name;` order declaration but precedes any style rule or `@layer {}` block", so the imported sheet applies. The page is re-declared windows-1252 (`pageCharset`), so the UTF-8 `é` decodes correctly ONLY if the sheet's `@charset` is honoured. §65.5: the global `p { margin-top: 8px }` beats the reset's `p { margin: 0 }`.
